mapper.sql: R.RSVT_SN, R.RSVT_NO, R.SCHL_NM, R.SCYR_NM, R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD, CASE R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '사건탐구' ELSE R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD END AS PRGRM_TYPE_NM, R.PRGRM_SN, P.PRGRM_NM, R.RSVT_YMD AS LRN_YMD, R.PIC_NM, R.RSVT_NOPE, R.ACTL_NOPE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL ) AS STUDENT_CNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL AND S.ATND_YN = 'Y' ) AS ATND_CNT, ROUND( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL AND S.ATND_YN = 'Y' ) / GREATEST( COALESCE(R.RSVT_NOPE, 0), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL ), 1 ) * 100 ) AS ATTENDANCE_RATE, R.REG_DT
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_MST R LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_SN = R.PRGRM_SN AND P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD

SELECT
FROM EDU_RSVT_MST R LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_SN = R.PRGRM_SN AND P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHERE R.RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND R.DEL_DT IS NULL

SELECT S.STDNT_SN, S.RSVT_SN, S.STDNT_NO, S.CLAS_NM, S.CLAS_NO, CASE WHEN S.STDNT_NM_DEL_DT IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE S.STDNT_NM END AS STDNT_NM, S.ATND_YN, S.TEAM_NM, S.ASGN_NM, S.ROUTE_CN, S.LRN_STTS_CD, CASE S.LRN_STTS_CD WHEN 'READY' THEN '진행 전' WHEN 'ING' THEN '진행 중' WHEN 'DONE' THEN '완료' ELSE S.LRN_STTS_CD END AS LRN_STTS_NM, S.PRGRS_RT, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_LRN_PRGRS_LOG L WHERE L.RSVT_SN = S.RSVT_SN AND L.STDNT_SN = S.STDNT_SN ) > 0 THEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.STEP_CD) FROM EDU_LRN_PRGRS_LOG L WHERE L.RSVT_SN = S.RSVT_SN AND L.STDNT_SN = S.STDNT_SN AND L.STEP_STTS_CD = 'DONE' ) WHEN S.LRN_STTS_CD = 'DONE' THEN 4 WHEN S.LRN_STTS_CD = 'ING' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS DONE_STEP_CNT, 4 AS TOTAL_STEP_CNT, S.STDNT_NM_DEL_DT FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(S.STDNT_NO, ''), S.STDNT_SN) AS UNSIGNED), S.STDNT_SN

SELECT A.LRN_ANS_SN, A.RSVT_SN, A.STDNT_SN, A.ANS_TYPE_CD, CASE A.ANS_TYPE_CD WHEN 'WORKSHEET' THEN '활동지' WHEN 'EVALUATION' THEN '학생 평가지' WHEN 'SURVEY' THEN '학생 설문지' WHEN 'TEACHER_EVALUATION' THEN '선생님 운영 평가지' ELSE A.ANS_TYPE_CD END AS ANS_TYPE_NM, A.STEP_CD, CASE A.STEP_CD WHEN 'STEP1' THEN 'STEP1' WHEN 'STEP2' THEN 'STEP2' WHEN 'STEP3' THEN 'STEP3' WHEN 'STEP4' THEN 'STEP4' ELSE A.STEP_CD END AS STEP_NM, A.CARD_CLSF_CD, CASE A.CARD_CLSF_CD WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션카드' WHEN 'SEARCH' THEN '탐구카드' WHEN 'EXPERIENCE' THEN '체험카드' WHEN 'DESIGN' THEN '설계활동' WHEN 'MEDIA' THEN '메이커활동' ELSE A.CARD_CLSF_CD END AS CARD_CLSF_NM, A.CNTN_SN, A.QSTNR_SN, A.QSTN_SN, A.QSTN_CN, A.ANS_CN FROM EDU_LRN_ANS A WHERE A.RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND A.DEL_DT IS NULL
AND ( A.STDNT_SN = #{stdntSn} OR A.STDNT_SN IN ( SELECT OLD_S.STDNT_SN FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT CUR_S INNER JOIN EDU_RSVT_STDNT OLD_S ON OLD_S.RSVT_SN = CUR_S.RSVT_SN AND OLD_S.STDNT_SN != CUR_S.STDNT_SN AND OLD_S.STDNT_NO <=> CUR_S.STDNT_NO AND OLD_S.CLAS_NM <=> CUR_S.CLAS_NM AND OLD_S.CLAS_NO <=> CUR_S.CLAS_NO AND OLD_S.STDNT_NM <=> CUR_S.STDNT_NM WHERE CUR_S.RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND CUR_S.STDNT_SN = #{stdntSn} AND CUR_S.DEL_DT IS NULL AND OLD_S.DEL_DT IS NOT NULL ) )
AND A.ANS_TYPE_CD = #{ansTypeCd}
ORDER BY FIELD(A.ANS_TYPE_CD, 'WORKSHEET', 'EVALUATION', 'SURVEY', 'TEACHER_EVALUATION'), CASE WHEN A.STEP_CD REGEXP '^QUEST[0-9]+$' THEN 1 WHEN A.STEP_CD REGEXP '^MISSION[0-9]+$' THEN 1 WHEN A.STEP_CD REGEXP '^STEP[0-9]+$' THEN 2 ELSE 9 END, CASE WHEN A.STEP_CD REGEXP '^(QUEST|MISSION|STEP)[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.STEP_CD, '^[A-Z]+', '') AS UNSIGNED) ELSE 999 END, A.LRN_ANS_SN
